summary: Voters in Bilari mostly complain about electricity (a death from low-hanging wires and a four-day outage), unpaid sugar cane dues, waterlogged roads and unpaved colony roads; sourced benefits are very thin.

positives.english: A case was registered against the mill owner over cane dues, so at least some action was taken
positives.hindi: मिल मालिक पर गन्ना बकाये का मुकदमा दर्ज हुआ, कार्रवाई तो हुई
positives.basis: Police case registered at Bilari police station against the owner of the Ayudhya sugar mill, Bilari, and two others over unpaid cane dues (Patrika, 4 Sep 2025). Weak positive: this is a case, not a payment; dues of Rs 39.91 crore were still outstanding in that report.

positives.english: After DM pressure, the mill paid Rs 3 crore, so at least something came
positives.hindi: डीएम के दबाव से मिल ने 3 करोड़ रुपये दिए, कुछ तो मिला
positives.basis: Bilari sugar mill paid Rs 3 crore after strong pressure from the District Magistrate; about Rs 18.92 crore still remained after that payment (Amar Ujala, Moradabad, 30 Oct 2024). Weak positive: partial payment, 2024, and the current status was not found.

positives.english: At least the underground pipelines are laid, only the tank is still pending
positives.hindi: भूमिगत पाइपलाइन तो बिछ गई, बस टंकी बाकी है
positives.basis: Villagers of Sherpur Maafi, Bilari block, said underground water pipelines were laid about two years ago, but no water tank has been built yet (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 13 Jun 2026). Weak positive: the work is partly done and the source is a complaint. AC membership of Sherpur Maafi village unconfirmed.

positives.hindi: *राशन में मुफ्त अनाज मिल रहा है
positives.basis: Inference: no Bilari-specific source found in searches; free ration (PMGKAY) is a central scheme running in UP. Not verified for Bilari.

positives.hindi: *कुछ घरों को उज्ज्वला गैस कनेक्शन मिला है
positives.basis: Inference: no Bilari-specific source found; a general UP-wide scheme assumed to reach some Bilari households. Not verified.

negatives.english: In Veer Nagar a life was lost to hanging wires, councillors say the power department is negligent
negatives.hindi: वीरनगर में लटके तारों से जान गई, पार्षद बोले बिजली विभाग लापरवाह है
negatives.basis: Young qawwal Babbu (Bablu) Masoodi died from touching low-hanging live wires at an empty plot in Veer Nagar mohalla, Bilari, on a Friday night. Councillors blamed the electricity department's gross negligence and residents protested (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 11 Oct 2026). Allegation by councillors and residents.

negatives.english: The sugar mill still owes farmers between 33 and 40 crore rupees in cane dues
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिल पर किसानों का 33 से 40 करोड़ बकाया है
negatives.basis: Ayudhya sugar mill, Bilari: Rs 39.91 crore 'still due' as of 2 Sep 2025 per Patrika (4 Sep 2025); Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2025) gave the dues owed to cane farmers linked to the Bilari cooperative cane committee as Rs 33 crore. Figures differ by source; current status not found.

negatives.english: Feeder had no power for four days, farmers protested at the power house
negatives.hindi: चार दिन बिजली नहीं आई, किसानों ने बिजलीघर पर प्रदर्शन किया
negatives.basis: Bilari Dehat power house on Station Road, Bilari: burned-out tripping coil and storm-damaged poles left the East rural feeder without supply for four days; farmers with tubewells protested at the power house and SDO office and submitted a memorandum (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 23 Apr 2026). Feeder villages named in the report (Mundiya Raja, Gwarkhera, Milak Nagaliya, Harora, Roja, Dharmpur Kalan) not separately confirmed as inside the AC.

negatives.english: In the new colony, several lanes still have no paved road
negatives.hindi: नई कॉलोनी की कई गलियों में पक्की सड़क नहीं बनी है
negatives.basis: Ward 25 of Bilari Nagar Palika Parishad: several streets in a newly developed colony lack paved roads. The municipal road from Paint Bazaar via Sarkari Hospital Road to Shahabad Road is broken in places; tender completed but construction not started. Residents say the low PWD Shahabad Road floods in rain (Amar Ujala, 2 Aug 2026). MLA of Bilari constituency also raised broken roads in the rains (Amar Ujala, 6 Aug 2026).

negatives.english: When it rains, water collects on the new road and Shahabad Road
negatives.hindi: बारिश में नई सड़क और शाहबाद रोड पर पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Bilari town: continuous rain from 26 Sep 2026 caused waterlogging on Naya Sadak, Purana Dakhana Road and Shahabad Road, causing difficulty for pedestrians and drivers (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 27 Sep 2026).

notes: AC confirmed as No. 30 Bilari, Moradabad, reserved None (Wikipedia). Wikipedia says the constituency is split between Moradabad and Sambhal districts and gives no tehsil or village list. Bilari town membership is taken from the Amar Ujala 6 Aug 2026 report, which quotes the Bilari-constituency MLA asking for public toilets in Bilari town; Bilari Nagar Palika (Ward 25), Bilari sugar mill and Bilari Dehat power house are therefore treated as inside the AC. Sherpur Maafi (Bilari block) and the feeder villages in the 23 Apr 2026 report are not confirmed as inside the AC. Sugar dues differ by source: Rs 18.92 crore after a Rs 3 crore payment (Oct 2024), Rs 39.91 crore (Patrika, Sep 2025), Rs 33 crore (Amar Ujala, Oct 2025), about Rs 15 crore (Sherpur article, Jun 2026); current figure not found. Positives 1-3 are weak sourced items (a case, a partial payment, and partly laid pipelines). Positives 4-5 are unverified inferences, flagged. Searched without finding Bilari-specific sources: Bilari CHC/hospital services, transformer or substation upgrade completion, PMAY housing beneficiaries, Jal Jeevan tank completion, road or drain completion, MLA development foundation/inauguration. Excluded: Jan 2021 Amar Ujala report of Rs 14 crore paid by Bilari mill (too old); Bilari-Sirsi RCC drain (tender only, not finished); Ratanpur Kala road and Kundarki road foundation stones (Kundarki AC); Kanth CHC X-ray (Kanth AC); Thakurdwara plaque item (other town). An unfetched Patrika report on queues at the Bilari tehsil community centre (page dated 2 Aug 2026) may be a field lead for a CHC negative. Field check suggested: Veer Nagar wires, Sherpur Maafi tank, Bilari Dehat feeder, Nai Sadak and Shahabad Road drainage, sugar dues status. Voice pass (Round 3): P1 weak positive: a police case, not a payment (basis). P2 weak positive: partial payment in 2024; about Rs 18.92 crore remained per basis. P3 weak positive: partly done; source is a villagers' complaint. N1 now attributes the negligence charge to councillors as an allegation. N2 gives the range of the two reported dues figures (33 and 39.91 crore) because sources differ. N4 narrowed to unpaved lanes in the colony; the waterlogging detail stays in N5. P4 and P5 remain inference.

round2.changes: Verified all 9 cited URLs (each fetched and matched). Corrected Ward 25 basis (municipal road vs PWD road) and the mill spelling. Replaced the Sherpur Maafi negative with a sourced Bilari Dehat power-house outage (23 Apr 2026). Positives: replaced 2 inferences with the Oct 2024 Rs 3 crore mill payment and the Sep 2025 case; the Sherpur pipeline item stays as weak sourced positive; ration and Ujjwala remain flagged inferences. Re-ranked negatives by impact. Added Bilari-specific negatives count and AC membership reasoning to notes.
